assertion,asserts,contained_in,contains,describes,records,relation	Registry Entry
Source Assertion
The relation (Registry Entry, Source Assertion) specifies that a registry entry records a source assertion. In this relationship, the source assertion is part of the registry entry, and the registry entry serves as a container that documents the assertion independently of any other entries in the registry. The registry entry contains the source assertion, capturing it without evaluating other registry entries. This relationship indicates that the registry entry records and holds the source assertion, thereby preserving the assertion’s information within the registry.<SEP>The registry entry records a source assertion.<SEP>Registry Entry records a source assertion.

Registry Entry
The relation **(Fictional Reference World, Registry Entry)** indicates that a registry entry is situated within the Fictional Reference World. It confirms the entry’s location inside this world and specifies that the entry describes a relationship that is part of that fictional context. The relation therefore serves to both locate the registry entry within the Fictional Reference World and to define the nature of the relationship it records.<SEP>The registry entry describes the relationship within the fictional reference world.<SEP>The registry entry is situated within the fictional reference world.<SEP>Registry entry describes the relationship within the fictional reference world.
